# External sources

Reference/upstream source trees used during Lagi development:

- **Azel** — primary reconstructed PDS runtime and source-level behavior reference
- **ATOLM** — decompilation and accuracy reference
- **pds-tools** — PDS asset and format documentation/tooling

The Azel submodule is currently pinned at:

```text
c52329fb257561abff05531a8335e34137d67098
```

Lagi-specific Vita adaptations are kept in the main repository so the upstream reference remains easy to compare against.

Copyrighted Panzer Dragoon Saga game data is not stored here.
